description.ja: 「月刊ヒーローズ」で連載中の『ULTRAMAN』より、ULTRAMAN[B TYPE] がFigure-rise Standardに登場！
description.en: From "ULTRAMAN " currently being serialized in " Heroes", ULTRAMAN [B TYPE] is now available in Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: • 本体表面の銀色はエクストラフィニッシュ、赤色はグロスインジェクションで質感を再現。
description.en: • The silver color on the main body surface is extra finish, and the red color is gloss injection to reproduce the texture.

description.ja: • ボディに収めることができる新設計のLEDユニットが付属。スペシウムコアと両目を同時に発光させることができる。スペシウムコアは青と赤の２色を再現。
description.en: • Comes with a newly designed LED unit that can be stored in the body. The Specium Core and both eyes can emit light at the same time. Specium core reproduces two colors, blue and red.

description.ja: • スペシウムエフェクトパーツとして３種のクリアパーツが付属。各種戦闘シーンを演出できる。
description.en: • Three types of clear parts are included as specium effect parts. You can create various battle scenes.

description.ja: • スペシウムブレードは両脇に、スペシウムスラッシュは両手に、それぞれ取り付けが可能。
description.en: • The Specium Blade can be attached to both sides, and the Specium Slash can be attached to both hands.

description.ja: • 原作者・清水栄一氏によるオリジナルデザインの大型ライフル「マルス133改」が付属。
description.en: • A large rifle "Mars 133 Kai" originally designed by the original author Eiichi Shimizu is included.

description.ja: • 各種ハンドパーツ、オリジナル武装専用の握り手（右）が付属。
description.en: • Various hand parts and grip hand (right) for original weapons are included.

accessories.en: Clear effect parts (Specium slash x 2) (Specium blade x 2) (Specium ray x 1)
